title: Cancel shipment
purpose: End a draft or packed shipment that will not be sent.
summary: End a draft or packed shipment that will not be sent. Managers and administrators only.

tasks.title: Deal with its specimens
steps: Put them back from the request, or add them to another shipment.

good_to_know: Cancelled is final. The timeline is kept.
Its specimens stay picked for the request.
A dispatched shipment cannot be cancelled.

sections.title: Who can use it
paragraphs: Managers and administrators, while the shipment is a draft or packed. It opens in the form dialog over the page you came from; without JavaScript it is a page of its own. Cancel returns without saving.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required, kept in the timeline and history. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: What happens
paragraphs: The shipment becomes Cancelled (final) and keeps its timeline. Its specimens stay picked for the request: put them back or add them to another shipment.
If someone changed the record after you opened the form, saving is refused with a message to reload; your entries stay in the form and the next save uses the current version.
